$comment: Non-secret settings for the proof-of-concept Retell agent. Field names match the Retell API (retell-sdk 6.x). Numbers, names, and the API key come from environment variables read by create-agent.mjs.

post_call_analysis_data.name: disclosure_given
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if, before asking for the caller's name or number, the agent said in any wording that a transcript of the call is kept and that it is not recorded. False if the agent asked for a name or number first, or never said it.

post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: new_client: a person seeking help with a new matter or unsure. existing_client: says they already have a case with the firm. other: vendor, opposing counsel, court, sales, wrong number. unknown: could not tell.

post_call_analysis_data.name: language
post_call_analysis_data.description: The language the caller mostly used.

post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_full_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's full name as confirmed. Empty if not given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_phone
post_call_analysis_data.description: The best callback number as confirmed, digits only with country code if known. If the caller confirmed the number they were calling from, write CALLER_ID.

post_call_analysis_data.name: reason
post_call_analysis_data.description: Only if the caller volunteered why they were calling: one sentence in their own words. Empty if they did not say. Their answer to 'new matter or existing case' is not a reason. No legal characterization added by the agent.

post_call_analysis_data.name: asked_for_senior_management
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller asked for Walter, Peg, or Anthony by name.

post_call_analysis_data.name: requested_person
post_call_analysis_data.description: Name of the person the caller asked for by name, if any. Empty otherwise.

post_call_analysis_data.name: message_taken
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the agent told the caller someone would call them back instead of connecting them.

post_call_analysis_data.name: legal_information_given
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the agent gave legal information, an opinion on the caller's matter, a case evaluation, a fee, a case timeline, or a likely outcome. Not legal information: office hours, callback time frames, that the firm is fully remote, who the caller will talk to, and the fixed line 'That's exactly what our team will go over with you.' Should be false.

post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_mood
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's emotional state at their most intense point: calm; frustrated (annoyed, impatient); angry (raised voice, complaints, demands); distressed (crying, hopeless, mentions of self-harm).

post_call_analysis_data.name: upset_about
post_call_analysis_data.description: If the caller was frustrated, angry, or distressed: what they were upset about, in their own words, one sentence. Otherwise empty.
